purpose: Curated prospective-client questions to answer on snsco.in. Educational answers only (BCI Rule 36). Not yet researched or written. Source: legal-query-bank in firm profile/seo-deliverables.
answer_standard: Answer the question directly in the first paragraph, in general terms, as on a stated date
State the governing statute, forum, time limits and procedure; confirm every provision and case from two sources
Say plainly where the law is unsettled or differs by State
No call to contact the firm, no 'we can help', no fee or free-consultation language, no results or experience claims
No client stories, names or outcomes; hypotheticals labelled as such
Link to related guides, articles and the glossary; no comparisons with other lawyers

queue.query: Can the karta sell ancestral property without the consent of other family members?
queue.angle: Coparcenary property, karta's powers, legal necessity, 2005 amendment, Vineeta Sharma v Rakesh Sharma (2020), how a sale is challenged, limitation
queue.verify: Hindu Succession Act Sec 6 as amended in 2005; Vineeta Sharma (2020) 9 SCC 1; limitation articles for setting aside alienations

queue.query: How do I check that a property title is clear before buying?
queue.angle: Chain of title, encumbrance certificate, mutation, revenue records, possession, litigation search, builder or authority approvals, what each document does and does not prove; Noida, Delhi and UP examples
queue.verify: Registration Act; Transfer of Property Act Sec 54 and 55; UP and Delhi record systems (verify); Supreme Court on due diligence and bona fide purchaser

queue.query: Adverse possession: how many years, what must be proved and what it cannot do
queue.angle: Limitation Act Art 64 and 65, hostile and open possession, Supreme Court rulings (Ravinder Kaur Grewal 2019, Karnataka Board of Wakf 2004 and recent), government land, permissive possession
queue.verify: Limitation Act 1963 Art 64 65 112; Ravinder Kaur Grewal v Manjit Kaur (2019) 8 SCC 729; recent SC rulings (verify)

queue.query: How a registered sale deed can be cancelled: grounds, forum and limitation
queue.angle: Section 31 Specific Relief Act, fraud, forgery, void versus voidable, declaration, limitation, deed cancellation by executant, State registry rules
queue.verify: Specific Relief Act Sec 31 (as amended 2018); Limitation Act Art 59; Registration Act Sec 17; recent SC rulings (verify)

queue.query: Mutual consent divorce: procedure, cooling-off period and timeline
queue.angle: Section 13B Hindu Marriage Act, two motions, six-month period and waiver (Amardeep Singh 2017), documents, jurisdiction, informational only
queue.verify: Hindu Marriage Act Sec 13B; Amardeep Singh v Harveen Kaur (2017) 8 SCC 746; Shilpa Sailesh v Varun Sreenivasan (2023); Special Marriage Act Sec 28

queue.query: Who inherits when there is no will? Intestate succession under Hindu law and a note on other personal laws
queue.angle: Hindu Succession Act Sec 8 to 16 classes of heirs, widow, children, Class II, self-acquired versus ancestral, brief on Muslim, Christian and Parsi law, succession certificate link
queue.verify: Hindu Succession Act 1956 Sec 8, 15; Indian Succession Act; Arunachala Gounder (2022)

queue.query: Gratuity not paid or forfeited: eligibility, calculation and the claim route
queue.angle: Payment of Gratuity Act 1972 and the Code on Social Security 2020 position (verify commencement), five-year rule, formula, forfeiture limits, controlling authority, interest
queue.verify: Payment of Gratuity Act Sec 4, 7, 8; Code on Social Security 2020 gratuity provisions and notified date (verify); recent SC rulings

queue.query: Wrongful termination: what remedies an employee has in India
queue.angle: Workman versus non-workman, Industrial Relations Code position (verify commencement), civil suit, writ for public employer, notice and compensation, informational only
queue.verify: Industrial Disputes Act Sec 25F and IR Code 2020 provisions (verify in-force status); recent SC rulings

queue.query: When are directors personally liable for a company's acts?
queue.angle: Veil piercing, officer in default, Section 141 NI Act, tax and labour statutes, Section 339 Companies Act, independent and non-executive directors, recent SC rulings
queue.verify: Companies Act 2013 Sec 2(60), 447, 339; NI Act Sec 141; SC on director liability (verify)

queue.verify: Transfer of Property Act Sec 44; Partition Act 1893 Sec 4; recent SC and Allahabad HC rulings (verify)
